summary: Built production containerization, CI/CD pipeline, health and readiness endpoints, and deployment configuration for multi-service Railway release.
evidence: Multi-stage Dockerfile built and verified with python:3.13-slim, binding to 0.0.0.0, dynamic PORT injection (${PORT:-8000}), container HEALTHCHECK, and automated startup migrations.
GitHub Actions CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) configured with PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7 service containers, automated Alembic migrations, and pytest execution on every push and PR.
Liveness probe GET /health returns HTTP 200 immediately for process monitoring.
Readiness probe GET /ready validates PostgreSQL (SELECT 1) and Redis connectivity before routing traffic, returning HTTP 503 if database is unready.
Railway configuration and rollback architecture documented in apps/api/railway.json, apps/api/.env.railway.example, and apps/api/docs/DEPLOYMENT_AND_ROLLBACK.md.
All 64 tests passing in pytest across all 10 modules.
